title: NAS security mode control initiation by the network

entities.name: NAS Security Mode Control Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by AMF to establish NAS security context with UE. Involves sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND message and starting timer T3560.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE to initiate NAS security mode control procedure. Contains security algorithms, ngKSI, and other security parameters.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to AMF to confirm successful security mode control procedure completion.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to AMF to indicate security mode control procedure failure.

entities.name: T3560
entities.description: Timer started by AMF when sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND. Stopped upon receiving SECURITY MODE COMPLETE or SECURITY MODE REJECT.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Information element indicating NAS key set identifier. Can indicate native security context, mapped security context, or null context (000).

entities.name: Selected NAS security algorithms
entities.description: Information element containing selected 5G NAS security algorithms (5G-IA0, 5G-EA0) and optionally EPS NAS security algorithms.

entities.name: Additional 5G security information
entities.description: Information element containing RINMR bit to request retransmission of initial NAS message.

entities.name: Selected EPS NAS security algorithms
entities.description: Information element containing selected EPS NAS security algorithms (EIA0, EEA0) for interworking.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Information element containing EAP-success message for EAP-based authentication scenarios.

entities.name: Horizontal derivation parameter
entities.description: Information element for horizontal key derivation during mobility and registration updates.

entities.name: Emergency services without valid security context
entities.description: Condition where security mode control is initiated for emergency services when no valid 5G NAS security context is available.

entities.name: N26 interface and S1 mode supported
entities.description: Condition where AMF supports N26 interface and UE indicates S1 mode support in 5GMM capability.

entities.name: Integrity protected with new 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Property indicating SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is integrity protected with new security context but sent unciphered.

relations.description: NAS security mode control procedure includes sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
AMF starts timer T3560 when initiating security mode control procedure.
Receipt of SECURITY MODE COMPLETE stops timer T3560.
Receipt of SECURITY MODE REJECT stops timer T3560.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains ngKSI IE to indicate security context.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains selected NAS security algorithms IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND is integrity protected with new 5G NAS security context but sent unciphered.
Emergency services without valid security context condition requires setting 5G-IA0 and 5G-EA0 as selected algorithms.
N26 interface and S1 mode supported condition requires including Selected EPS NAS security algorithms IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains Additional 5G security information IE when integrity check fails.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains EAP message IE for EAP-based authentication scenarios.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains horizontal derivation parameter for key derivation.
